sourceNote: McDonald's Deutschland publishes its nutrition per product on each product page (Nährwerte per 100 g and per portion with the portion's weight, and allergens); https://www.mcdonalds.com/de/de-de/produkte/naehrwert-und-allergeninformationen.html says the values are rounded European averages from accredited laboratories for standard recipes and portions. There is no PDF: each page reads its table from the site's own item data service, named in the page as data-product-api-url, recorded per row as dataURL with the SHA-256 of the response text. portionMilliliters is set only where the site itself states the sold volume, in the product's name or the page address; the McCafé Small, Regular and Grande cups have no stated volume on the site and keep only the table's portion weight.
sha256Note: SHA-256 over the per-row sha256 values concatenated in ascending item id; each row sha256 is the SHA-256 of the raw itemDetails response text.
